That distinction feels right. This is a different situation from a brand-new collection — here I've got plenty saved, I just don't have anything sitting in my "read later" pile right now. So it makes sense that the message is the gentler "Nothing to read later" rather than acting like I have no bookmarks at all, and that search and my labels stay put, because the rest of my collection is still there to browse. And the "View all bookmarks" button gives me an easy way straight back to everything. That's exactly the right handling for an empty shelf inside a full cupboard.

This is good. What's next?
